newsitem.title: USA: Key lawmaker will support Conrail plan.
newsitem.headline: Key lawmaker will support Conrail plan.

text.p: The chairman of the House Transportation and Infrastructure committee said Monday he would support a proposal by CSX Corp and Norfolk Southern Corp to buy Conrail Inc.
"The planned dual acquisition of Conrail appears to offer major competitive benefits for Pennsylvania, the Northeast and the nation," Rep Bud Shuster, R-Pa., said in a statement.
A joint application has been filed with the Surface Transportation Board for the purchase.
Shuster said the plan would provide new economic opportunities for shippers, railroad employees and the overall industry.
"I will support this merger plan to ensure that the benefits committed to all parties are fully realized," he said.
